classes_access_pin_state.name: classes_access_pin_state
classes_access_pin_state.value: ("classes"."access_pin_enabled" and "classes"."access_pin_encrypted" is not null) or (not "classes"."access_pin_enabled" and "classes"."access_pin_encrypted" is null)

reporting_requirements_target.name: reporting_requirements_target
reporting_requirements_target.value: ("reporting_requirements"."kind" = 'credential' and "reporting_requirements"."credential_type_id" is not null and "reporting_requirements"."student_field" is null) or ("reporting_requirements"."kind" = 'student_field' and "reporting_requirements"."student_field" is not null and "reporting_requirements"."credential_type_id" is null)

attendance_active_class_student_unique.name: attendance_active_class_student_unique
attendance_active_class_student_unique.where: "attendance"."removed_at" is null and "attendance"."student_id" is not null

attendance_participant_xor.name: attendance_participant_xor
attendance_participant_xor.value: ("attendance"."student_id" is not null) <> ("attendance"."guest_id" is not null)

attendance_removal_fields.name: attendance_removal_fields
attendance_removal_fields.value: ("attendance"."removed_at" is null and "attendance"."removed_by_user_id" is null and "attendance"."removal_reason" is null) or ("attendance"."removed_at" is not null and "attendance"."removed_by_user_id" is not null and nullif(btrim("attendance"."removal_reason"), '') is not null)

attendance_credit_adjustment_fields.name: attendance_credit_adjustment_fields
attendance_credit_adjustment_fields.value: ("attendance"."credit_adjustment_reason" is null and "attendance"."credit_adjusted_by_user_id" is null and "attendance"."credit_adjusted_at" is null) or (nullif(btrim("attendance"."credit_adjustment_reason"), '') is not null and "attendance"."credit_adjusted_by_user_id" is not null and "attendance"."credit_adjusted_at" is not null)

attendance_manual_fields.name: attendance_manual_fields
attendance_manual_fields.value: ("attendance"."is_manual" = false and "attendance"."manual_recorded_by_user_id" is null) or ("attendance"."is_manual" = true and "attendance"."manual_recorded_by_user_id" is not null)
